title: Undisclosed Excursions LLC

services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Experience the best fly fishing Juneau has to offer! Fly fish in remote Alaskan wilderness locations near Juneau for native salmon, steelhead, trout, dolly varden, & more with Undisclosed Excursions. Your guide will pick you up and take you to a remote river on a jet boat where they will give fishing instruction according to your skill level. Whether you are a die hard fisherman or want to try something new, we have you covered! Target species are dependent on the season. If you have a specific fish you want to target, we can book you accordingly. All charters are PRIVATE, and excursions are available in half day or full day trips. Half day trips are 4-5 hours, boat launch to boat takeout.
